                  (@List.map.{0, 0} P Rat

explicit_theorems.statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D)

  (schedule : DefiKernel.Interleaving.Schedule) (lf rf : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D)))
      (@DefiKernel.Atomic.admit P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundaries policy left right schedule)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    And
      (@Eq.{1} Bool
        (@DefiKernel.Composition.validateCatalog P A D inst inst_1 inst_2
          (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.registry P A D cfg) (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.catalog P A D cfg))
        Bool.true)
      (And
        (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
          (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg
            (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left) left)
          (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf))
        (And
          (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
            (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg
              (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right) right)
            (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) rf))
          (And
            (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.PolicyFailure P A D) PUnit.{1})
              (@DefiKernel.Atomic.checkPolicy P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 policy boundaries left right)
              (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Atomic.PolicyFailure P A D) PUnit.{1} PUnit.unit.{1}))
            (@DefiKernel.Interleaving.Complete P A D left right schedule))))
